notes.title: Gyro FreeAim Update
notes.notes:
This update brings FreeAim 3Axis which uses the Yaw, Pitch and Roll of the controller to represent the position of the gun in the world. On the lowest sensitivity setting it matches 1:1 the controller direction relative to the starting point.

3Axis for the whole camera aiming does not twist the camera but takes into account the Yaw, Pitch and Roll to find the direction.

New SteamInput Configurations and Actions with better settings for sticks, a new Touchpad Action and a few extra Actions that I want to use in the future.

Better laser scope.

Updated to use the Steamworks 153A SDK.
